finding: Python 3.11+ MCP server using FastMCP. Entry point: server.py (988 lines). 15 @mcp.tool() decorators. DB: SQLite at db/bible.db. Package: pyproject.toml with mcp, sqlite-vec, sentence-transformers, boto3.

15 tools total: book_list, verse_lookup, parallel_versions, semantic_search, morphology_analysis, critical_apparatus, patristic_commentary, save_patristic_original, cross_references, word_study, authenticity_report, dss_lookup, canon_history, text_comparison, chapter_study. README lists 12 but actual count is 15.

Data pipeline: ingest/ has 11 scripts. init_schema.py creates 7+ tables: verses, morphology, apparatus, patristic, cross_refs, dss, verse_embeddings. External data via setup.sh (6 git clones). Local data from koine-anki repo via KOINE_ANKI_PATH env var.

Key workflows: (1) make setup -> init DB, (2) ./setup.sh -> download+ingest external, (3) make run -> start MCP server, (4) make test -> quick sanity check. S3 bucket bible-study-cache-609009159737 used for LLM analysis cache. sync_from_s3.sh syncs DB to ~/.kiro/mcp-servers/bible-tools/db/

AWS usage: Bedrock claude-haiku-4-5 for geo extraction in chapter_study tool. S3 bucket bible-study-cache-609009159737 (us-east-1) for caching patristic/exegetical HTML analyses. boto3 required. Optional: index_patristic_llm.py uses Bedrock for LLM-based patristic indexing.

Supporting modules: books.py (canonical book resolution, 84 books, multilingual aliases), bible_places.py (geographic coordinates), map_generator.py (matplotlib+cartopy maps), study_html_generator.py (interactive HTML with S3 cache).
README says default version is SBLGNT but server.py verse_lookup default is 'SBLGNT' — however the actual version stored in DB from MorphGNT ingest is 'MorphGNT'. Potential confusion for users.
Versification normalization: Psalms (LXX/Vulgate offset), Joel (3 vs 4 chapters), Malachi (4 vs 3 chapters), Exodus 8. Auto-converts when querying. Note displayed when numbering differs.

chapter_study tool generates: study.html (interactive), map.png (cartopy), patristic_analysis.html (background), exegetical_analysis.html (background). Output to ~/bible-studies/<book>-<chapter>/ by default. Uses threading for background analyses.

Bible software common features: concordance search, cross-references, word study (Strong numbers), commentary integration, original language tools, verse lookup, passage comparison, text analysis. Key workflows: exegesis, word study, topical study, passage comparison.
Project uses AWS: S3 for caching (bible-study-cache bucket), Bedrock Runtime (Claude Sonnet) for LLM-based patristic indexing, lemma glosses, word morphology generation. Region: us-east-1.
